title: Subject:
prompt:
Subject:
White Sleeves Stretching to the Blue Sky

Main Figure:
A woman in her 20s standing on a low concrete wall, stretching both arms overhead with hands clasped. Large full-body placement in the center, depicting gray-blue sportswear and a white patterned windbreaker against a wide blue sky.

Person and Expression:
Small oval face, thin brown eyes, natural eyebrows, and pale pink lips. Facing the top right of the frame, looking up at the sky with a gentle smile. Long dark brown hair down, flowing to the left in the wind.

Clothing and Pose:
Gray-blue thin-strap sports top and high-waisted short sports pants. Layered with a thin long-sleeved zip jacket featuring black abstract patterns on a white background, worn open. White short socks and white platform sneakers. Standing with legs slightly crossed. Stretching both arms straight up, hands clasped above the head.

Background and Light:
Most of the background is a vivid blue sky, with white cumulus clouds at the bottom left and bottom edge, and a gray concrete wall at the very bottom. Strong direct sunlight from above, brightly illuminating the white sleeves and legs, creating short shadows in the folds of the clothes.

Composition and Camera:
Vertical 3:4. Strong low-angle wide-angle camera looking up from near the ground, capturing the whole body from soles to clasped hands. Figure placed centrally, tall and narrow, leaving wide blue sky margins above and to the sides. Shoes and wall near the bottom edge. Focus on the person, with the sky kept clear.

Texture and Style:
Photorealistic live-action photograph taken outdoors at noon. Precise rendering of sports fabric stretch and luster, thin jacket wrinkles, wind-blown hair, and white shoe texture.

Negative:
Alteration of arms clasped overhead; omission of the white patterned jacket.
